description: Skills to turn AI agents into Red Hat OpenShift GitOps engineers

interface.longDescription: Skills for Red Hat OpenShift GitOps — the productized Argo CD distribution. Covers Argo CD and Argo Rollouts as shipped by the OpenShift GitOps operator: knowledge and manifest generation, repository auditing, live cluster debugging, operations (install, deploy, promote, maintain), performance and scale tuning, and GitOps-first team onboarding. Argo Workflows and Argo Events are out of scope — they are separate upstream projects not shipped by the operator.
